La Niña, much like its warmer counterpart, El Niño, have far reaching global impacts extending beyond the Pacific Ocean.
@highlight

@highlight

B. NOAA
C. Climate Prediction Center
D. La Niña
E. El Niño
F. Pacific
G. ENSO Alert System
H. CPC
I. La Niña Advisory
J. Pacific Ocean
K. La Niña Watch

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
